_note: Adjudications for oldest-end batch 03, mid 2023. Includes one correction to batch 02. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

reviews.note: Correction to batch 02, which marked this first_mention. P7viEh9luCE@0 of 5 July 2023 is the earlier telling and takes first_mention; this September retelling is a restatement that adds the Italy tie.
Adds Argentina to the accession list and puts a countdown on it: five months left.
News round-up: Fukushima water release and the Trump mug shot.
The Ford and Nixon analogy makes this a succession claim, not an election one. Given August 2023, eleven months before Biden withdrew.

Left unsure on purpose. dem-shakeup-2024 reads as upheaval; this telling says great things are coming for the Democratic Party. Same subject, opposite valence, so it stays visible rather than folded in.
Bundles the stimulus image with the good-year word: the economy is pumped full of money to make everything look good, and 2024 is still called good.
Carries his clearest disclaimer about dates, and the aside about a generation that does not see death.
Three-part structure given as one word. The catastrophic event is left undescribed, which is what makes the set hard to score.
Supplies the coin device: focus on the bad or the good, it is a choice. That is what makes soar-2024 unfalsifiable as stated.
Confession of faith over his daughter.
Testimony of a $3,500 gift covering hospital bills.
Channel history: told to be on YouTube, 50,000 subscribers by August 2023.
One of the few places he names a political motive behind an event he is praying against.
The earliest telling, 5 July 2023, and it dates the origin further back to a prayer time around April 2022.

He gives the angel's count as 510 days here and as 569 days in XxwF--X7PLo@1593. Both land on 2 October, so at most one arithmetic can be right. Not merged: the count is the whole substance of this claim.
His standing account of his own error. Recorded as a claim rather than discarded as framing, because it is what every later miss is scored against.

The chickens episode, the clearest worked example: he apologised to his wife for missing it, then recovered it as either averted by prayer or merely early. Also the earliest food-shortage material in the corpus.
Sources the urgency to the 2014 visitation, and notes that the time frames he was shown were withheld.
Unusually checkable for a tribulation vision: a named chain on a named site.
Extends it to buildings generally: structures seen in 2014 that did not then exist are being built now.
